sessions.title: Blazor Under the Hood: Components, Binding, and Re-rendering
sessions.description: In this session we'll look at how Blazor actually works: what a component is, how parameters flow between parent and child, how two-way binding works, and when and why components re-render.

sessions.title: One UI to rule them all: Blazor Hybrid
sessions.description:
Companies that have invested in .NET solutions for years are now facing a crucial challenge: how to evolve WinForms or WPF applications toward modern, cross-platform experiences without rewriting everything from scratch.
With .NET MAUI and Blazor Hybrid, it is possible to adopt a gradual modernization approach, combining the reuse of business logic and C# components with new interfaces and cross-platform features.
During this session, we will analyze architectures, patterns, and strategies for integrating Blazor Hybrid into existing applications, evaluating the advantages, limitations, and real-world use cases of a unified .NET ecosystem for web, desktop, and mobile.

speakers.bio: Nicola Paro is a Solution Architect with over 10 years of experience in the industry, with a special focus on the Industrial IoT environment. He is passionate about software development, primarily using .NET, Blazor, and AI technologies.
speakers.tagLine: Senior Software Engineer | Solution Architect | Microsoft MVP

speakers.bio: Full-stack .NET developer with 2+ years of experience building business applications in .Net and Blazor. Based in Ormož.
